verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs include a dedicated debugging workflow ('Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix'), and its agent is driven by plain-language prompts in the IDE, the CLI ('Analyze this code') and cloud agents, including one that investigates and fixes a Sentry error. The evidence for the debugging workflow itself is only a one-line heading. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the debugging/troubleshooting workflow (e.g. log/stack-trace analysis, debugger integration), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language debugging quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries
